title: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000/year to small and marginal farmer families.
eligibility: Small & marginal farmers with less than 2 hectares land

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Provides farmers with affordable credit for crop production and allied activities.
benefit: Credit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% interest
eligibility: All farmers including tenant farmers and sharecroppers

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against losses from natural calamities.
benefit: Full coverage for crop loss; premium 2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas

title: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides soil health cards to farmers with crop-wise nutrient recommendations.
benefit: Free soil testing and fertilizer recommendations

title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchai Yojana (PMKSY)
description: Enhances water use efficiency and expands irrigation coverage.

title: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
description: Increases production of rice, wheat, pulses and coarse cereals.
benefit: Subsidized seeds, inputs and farm machinery

title: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
description: Pan-India electronic trading portal connecting agricultural produce markets.
eligibility: All farmers registered with local APMC

title: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
description: Promotes organic farming and sustainable agriculture.

title: Bihar Rajya Fasal Sahayata Yojana
description: Bihar state crop assistance scheme for crop damage due to natural calamities.
benefit: Up to ₹7,500/ha compensation for crop loss
eligibility: Farmers in Bihar with crop loss above 20%

title: Bihar Agricultural Input Subsidy
description: Input subsidy for farmers affected by floods and droughts in Bihar.

title: Mukhyamantri Krishi Ashirwad Yojana (MKAY)
description: Jharkhand govt provides annual income support to small and marginal farmers.

title: UP Agriculture Department Schemes
description: Various subsidies on farm equipment, seeds and fertilizers for UP farmers.

title: Maharashtra Shetkari Sanman Yojana
description: One-time financial support to debt-ridden farmers in Maharashtra.
eligibility: Distressed farmers in Maharashtra with outstanding loans

title: Rythu Bandhu Scheme
description: Telangana's investment support scheme for agriculture.

title: Bhavantar Bhugtan Yojana
description: Price deficiency payment scheme for farmers in MP.
eligibility: Farmers in Madhya Pradesh selling notified crops

title: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana (MP)
description: Additional ₹4,000/year income support on top of PM-Kisan for MP farmers.

title: Kalia Scheme (Odisha)
description: Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation in Odisha.
eligibility: Small farmers, landless agricultural households in Odisha

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana
description: Pension scheme providing ₹3,000/month after age 60 for farmers.

title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
description: Financing for post-harvest management infrastructure.
benefit: Loans up to ₹2 crore at 3% interest subsidy

title: National Bee Keeping & Honey Mission
description: Supports beekeeping as supplemental income for farmers.

title: PM Matsya Sampada Yojana
description: Supports fishermen and farmers engaged in aquaculture.
benefit: Subsidy on fish farming equipment and ponds

title: National Mission on Oilseeds and Oil Palm
description: Promotes oilseed and oil palm cultivation for edible oil self-sufficiency.
benefit: Seed subsidy, technical support, price support
eligibility: Farmers in identified oilseed growing districts

title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization
description: Promotes farm mechanization through subsidized farm equipment.

title: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY)
description: State plan scheme for agriculture development and allied sectors.

title: Bihar Diesel Subsidy Scheme
description: Diesel subsidy for farmers using diesel-powered irrigation pumps.

title: West Bengal Krishak Bandhu Scheme
description: Annual financial support and life insurance for WB farmers.

title: Rajasthan Mukhyamantri Krishak Sathi Yojana
description: Accidental insurance for farmers during agricultural activities.
benefit: ₹2 lakh on death, ₹50k-1 lakh for disability

title: Tamil Nadu Uzhavar Padhukappu Thittam
description: TN state crop insurance scheme for paddy and other crops.

title: Andhra Pradesh YSR Rythu Bharosa
description: Investment support for agriculture and allied activities.
eligibility: All farmer households in Andhra Pradesh

title: Gujarat Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana
description: Crop damage compensation for farmers in Gujarat.
eligibility: Farmers in Gujarat with crop damage
